title: A closed immersion into projective space supplies an ample invertible sheaf
statement: Let $A$ be a ring, let $n\ge0$, let $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}=\operatorname{Proj}(\mathbf Z[T_0,\dots,T_n])$ ($\deg T_k=1$) and $\mathbf P^n_A=\mathbf P(\{0,\dots,n\};\operatorname{Spec}A)=\operatorname{Spec}A\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], with projections $q:\mathbf P^n_A\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ and $\rho:\mathbf P^n_A\to\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$. Let $\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}}(1)=\widetilde{S(1)}$ be the twisting sheaf of $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] with its global sections $T_0,\dots,T_n$, and put $\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^n_A}(1)=\rho^*\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}}(1)$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $X$ be a scheme with a morphism $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ and a closed immersion $i:X\to\mathbf P^n_A$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $q\circ i=f$. Then $\mathcal L=i^*\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^n_A}(1)$ is an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] which is ample on $X$ in the absolute sense of Stacks Definition 01PS [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]; more precisely $X$ is quasi-compact, and for the sections $s_k=i^*\rho^*T_k\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L)$ ($k=0,\dots,n$) the non-vanishing loci $X_{s_k}$ are affine open subschemes covering $X$. (Since $\operatorname{Spec}A$ is affine, 'ample on $X$' is the same as '$f$-ample' in the sense of Stacks Morphisms Definition 01VH, by Morphisms Lemma 01VK; only the absolute notion is asserted and used here.)

proof.text: The Proj polynomial twist is invertible by the proved source instance Proj.isInvertible_twist_homogeneousSubmodule. Compare tensorPullback g with Scheme.Modules.pullback g by Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq applied to exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction and pullbackPushforwardAdjunction. IsInvertible.of_iso transports the usual pullback instance. Apply first to rho and then to i; this is the private, proved tensorPullback_invertible helper.

Recover a morphism out of the structure module from its global value at one: unitHomEquiv is injective, homOfGlobalSection_app_one computes each component, and Hom.app_presheaf_map plus map_one identifies the restrictions. Apply nonvanishingLocus_eq_compl_support_zeroLocus and the proved source theorem Proj.compl_support_zeroLocus_unitToTwist, using Proj.exists_mem_basicOpen_homogeneousSubmodule for the degree-one cover. Each integral coordinate therefore has precisely its Proj basic open as its nonvanishing locus. The recovery calculation is the proved private homOfGlobalSection_appTop_one helper.

Apply nonvanishing_tensorPullback first to rho and then to i. Transitivity of the two pointwise equivalences and the integral coordinate-locus equality identifies the twice-pulled coordinate locus with i inverse-image of standardOpen. The source theorem ProjectiveSpace.iSup_standardOpen and Scheme.Hom.iSup_preimage_eq_top give the cover. This uses the literal Proj twist and the chosen adjunction units occurring in the statement, so neither a glued-twist identification nor the still-holed projectiveSpace_standardCharts conjunction is required.

The proved source theorem ProjectiveSpace.isAffineOpen_standardOpen applies directly because the base is Spec A, hence affine. A closed immersion is an affine morphism; IsAffineOpen.preimage i proves each chart preimage affine. This is the affine special case of Constructions 01NG, already proved in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.Charts.

Each affine open is compact by IsAffineOpen.isCompact. Mathlib isCompact_iUnion applies to the finite type ULift (Fin (n+1)); the cover equality identifies the union with univ, and isCompact_univ_iff gives CompactSpace X. For each point select a covering chart by Opens.mem_iSup. The inverse right unitor L isomorphic to L.tensorPow 1 transports its coordinate section; the proved nonvanishingLocus_iso helper in AmpleIso preserves its locus. This affine chart and exponent one satisfy IsAmple exactly.

lead_note: L (2026-10-10): the citation of def-sc-ample (ample over a field) does not fit a scheme over Spec A; the absolute notion is def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module (Stacks 01PS), and over an affine base f-ample is the same as ample (01VK). split_report.summary: Statement repaired as the lead_note asked: the citation def-sc-ample (ampleness over a field) is replaced by def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module (absolute ampleness, Stacks 01PS), and the conclusion is now 'L is invertible and ample on X' (with the explicit affine cover X_{s_k}), which is what lem-weil-pbc-coherent-twist-global-generation needs; f-ampleness (01VH) is mentioned only as a remark (equal to ampleness over affine Spec A by 01VK, not 01VG which is a section tag). The statement now introduces O_{P^n_A}(1) explicitly as rho^* of the twisting sheaf of P^n_Z (def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf is for Proj of a graded ring, while P^n_A is the base change of def-nagata-projective-space-base-change), adding def-pc-module-pullback. The source place 01Q1 (open immersion into Proj(Gamma_*)) did not prove this and was replaced by 01PU (ample restricts to closed subschemes) with 01NG. Proof in five steps: identification of the glued and the S(1)-tilde twisting sheaf, invertibility and the non-vanishing loci via the standard-chart lemma, affineness of the charts and of their preimages under the closed immersion, then Definition 01PS with exponent 1. No new nodes. Route: lem-weil-pbc-projective-space-standard-charts and lem-weil-pbc-projective-space-twist-glued-identification are in unit sk-thm-reduction, not cited by sk-thm-p1; they are generic tool lemmas on P^n.

reviewed.note: 5 steps follow Stacks 01PU with 01NG: the two twisting sheaves identified (glued vs S(1)-tilde), L invertible via the standard-charts node, X_{s_k} = i^{-1}(D_+(T_k)), these are affine (closed immersion, affine form), ample by the definition with exponent 1. Statement now asserts absolute ampleness (01PS) over the affine base; f-ample is a remark (01VH/01VK). Tags 01PU, 01NG, 01MW, 01PS, 01VH, 01VK verified.
